summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Clark’s Bogey-Free Streak
items.text: Wyndham Clark opened the BMW Championship with his first-ever bogey-free 36 holes in a PGA Tour event and took the solo lead at Bellerive, positioning himself for a Player of the Year chance.

items.headline: Johnson Reflects on LIV Golf
items.text: Dustin Johnson, who joined LIV Golf in 2022, shared his thoughts on how LIV Golf 2.0 could impact the Open Championship.
